integrity: The complete covariance identity and sharp positivity bound are proved analytically. Randomized checks supplement but do not replace mathematical proof. Historical equivalence outside inspected literature remains a risk.
scientific_limitations: Four-dimensional orthotopes with strictly positive side lengths, two-dimensional Haar-uniform projections, ordinary Euclidean area and perimeter of the same shadow only. No claim for arbitrary nonorthogonal parallelotopes.
title: Exact mixed shadow-area–perimeter law and sharp positive-covariance bound for four-dimensional orthotopes
